tagline: The hand-drawn whiteboard, built so it keeps to itself: shared links, live collaboration, the session scene and even the fonts all come from your own server.
description: Excalidraw is a virtual whiteboard for sketches that look hand-drawn. This is a self-hosted build of it that keeps to itself: shared links, live collaboration, the session scene, the fonts and the icons all come from your own server, and the browser never contacts anyone else.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: Excalidraw
